The '''Remmon Nebula''' was an [[Color/Legends|orange]] and red [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]], passed through the nebula in their [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] while hunting down the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]].
